title: 007 First Light
description: 007 First Light is a story-driven action-adventure game presenting an original origin story for James Bond. Combining espionage, stealth, combat, gadgets, driving, and cinematic set pieces, the game delivers a modern high-fidelity PC experience. The gameplay showcased on SPCBM is captured in real time at 4K using Ultra graphics settings on high-end PC hardware.
